tasks.short: Write grant proposals for research funding.

steps.what: Read the mathematics call and her research record before any draft
Write the aim, the method and the budget this grant will carry
Place only those stated fields into grant proposals
Check the mathematics draft adds no research claim she did not state
Send the accepted proposals to procure the external funding

tasks.design: She writes the aim, the method, the budget lines and the publication titles in {DOCS}. A copy then places only those fields under the call headings and does not wait to be checked. She checks that the draft adds no research claim, and only the accepted proposals go once through the funder portal {OTHER}. A rejection sends nothing.
tasks.previous_blocker: The proposal was one write, so placing stated fields under call headings was not split from the science.
tasks.enabler_now: The call headings are a fixed list. Copying stated fields into them needs no model and adds no sentence.
tasks.still_hard: The aim and the method stay hers. A call whose headings do not match those fields cannot be filled by the copy.
tasks.human_edge: She decides the research the funding is for, and she rejects a draft that adds a claim.
tasks.altitude: Heading assembly and the portal send leave her week. She still writes the aim and the method, and she still accepts or rejects the proposals before they are sent.

reach.task: Record the publication title and its identifier
reach.learn: Which of her papers this proposal may cite, and that a paper with no identifier is typed by her

evidence.claim: Copying a stated aim, method, budget lines and named publications into fixed call headings is assembly and adds no claim. This is model knowledge.
Referees may not use generative AI; uploading a proposal breaches confidentiality.

assumptions: She writes and sends the proposal today, so the copy and the send keep her as the actor. The machine is only the future of those two steps.

Structured fields she writes before the copy: aim (one sentence), method (one sentence), budget lines (name and amount), publication titles (title plus record id). The librarian's catalogue supplies the record id. If a paper has no id she types the title in that stating step.
A blank aim produces no draft. The copy places only the stated fields. It does not compose a sentence and it does not wait for its own check.
The proposal is not uploaded to an external model. The funder portal is {OTHER}. A change to the draft voids the acceptance. A rejection sends nothing.
Upkeep hours are zero. A heading she rejects is dropped in the check, and there is no later rewrite queue.
unknowns: Which extra fields this funder's portal requires beyond aim, method, budget lines and publication titles.
research_questions: Which funder portal fields are mandatory beyond aim, method, budget lines and publication titles?

already_counted.description: The meaning check of the draft, already in the review before the send.

incremental.description: A rejected heading is dropped in the check. There is no later rewrite queue, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a year of calls whose headings rarely match, so she often rejects and the send rarely fires. High: a year of calls whose headings match the aim, method, budget and publications she stated, so the copy and the one send happen, while the science and the meaning check stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events.

steps.what: Read which campus and community events ask her to attend
Participate in those campus and community events in the room
Answer the public questions she chooses at that event

tasks.design: She reads which campus and community events she is asked to join, then participates in the room and answers the questions she chooses. No draft, no file and no send is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: Attendance was treated as something a workflow could schedule. The task is being there.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new removes the room. The event still needs her present.
tasks.still_hard: The public questions are not known before she is in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She is the person the campus or community event asked to be there.
tasks.altitude: The events stay in her week. She gains no new decision right, and no step is shorter.

reach.task: Set the time and place of the campus event
reach.learn: She attends and answers. She does not run the event.

evidence.claim: Being present and answering public questions is the task. A schedule does not do it. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: No machine step is added. She does not file a note of the event, and she does not send a follow-up, so no gate is added.
Upkeep hours are zero because no tool is introduced.
The instructional coordinator sets the time and place. That work stays outside her hours.
unknowns: Which of these events expect a prepared talk rather than attendance only.
research_questions: Which campus and community events expect a prepared mathematics talk rather than attendance only?

incremental.description: No tool is added, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both ends are zero. She still attends the campus and community events, and no step is shorter for a small reception or a long public talk.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Name the subject heading this outside reading needs
Compile bibliographies from records under that mathematics heading

loop.output: a short list of candidate titles
loop.check: A title is kept only if it has a DOI or a catalogue id. Whether the assignment needs it is not decided here.
loop.stop: Stop when a title has neither identifier, or when nothing further is proposed for this heading. If none resolve, she compiles by hand and nothing is written to the course.
loop.why_not_simpler: A heading query returns every record under that heading, including works she would not assign. Proposing a short list needs reading the record. She still judges fit.

steps.what: Judge which specialized materials belong on these assignments
Place the accepted mathematics bibliography on the course reading list

tasks.design: She names a subject heading in {DOCS}. A suggestion on the library catalogue {OTHER} proposes titles for that heading and drops any title with no DOI and no catalogue id. It does not wait. She judges which specialized materials belong, and only the accepted list is written onto the course reading list in {LMS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Searching the catalogue and judging which works the assignment needs were one pass.
tasks.enabler_now: A catalogue tool can propose titles for a heading she named and drop a title that does not resolve to a DOI or a catalogue id.
tasks.still_hard: She still opens the titles and decides which this assignment needs.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which specialized material this mathematics assignment needs.
tasks.altitude: Proposing titles and writing the accepted list leave her week. She still names the heading and still judges every title. She gains no new decision right.

reach.task: Enter the catalogue identifier and the subject heading
reach.learn: Which heading she named, and that fit for the assignment stays her judgement

evidence.claim: Scopus AI provides topic summaries and foundational papers for compiling bibliographies.
Invented references pass plagiarism checks unflagged, so a title with no DOI and no catalogue id is dropped.
The mathematics teacher still judges which specialized materials belong on the assignment. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: She compiles the bibliography today, so the suggestion and the course write keep her as the actor. The machine is only the future of those two steps.

The structured input is the subject heading she names before the suggestion. The librarian produces the DOI or catalogue id. A record with neither is not proposed. If the heading is blank, the suggestion does not run and she searches by hand.

The suggestion does not wait for its own check. She judges fit, including whether the work is one she would assign, not only whether an identifier is present. Only the accepted list is written to {LMS}. If she keeps nothing, nothing is written.
The reading list stays on the course site inside the organisation. The write is internal. Nothing is sent to a funder or a publisher.
Upkeep hours are zero. Titles she drops are handled in the judgement, and catalogue runtime is not her effort.
unknowns: Whether the library catalogue accepts her subject heading as a query.
research_questions: Does the library catalogue accept the subject heading she names, or only a free-text search she would still do by hand?

already_counted.description: Judging which titles belong, already in the review before the course write.

incremental.description: Titles she drops are handled in the judgement. There is no later rewrite queue, so upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: a year when few titles resolve for the heading, so she often compiles by hand and the course write rarely fires. High: a year when the heading matches and she keeps a short list, so the proposal and the course write happen, while judging every title stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The science in a grant, the events, and the choice of reading stay in her week. Only placing stated grant fields and sending the accepted proposals, and proposing titles then writing the accepted list, leave it. She gains no new decision right.
skills_to_grow: State the aim, the method, the budget lines and the publication titles before a proposal is copied.
Name a subject heading the catalogue already uses, and still judge every title.
Leave the research case, the event and the reading choice in her own hands.
role.ambitious_version: The week does not grow. She does not take more grants or more events because a proposal can be assembled or a reading list proposed.
